A quick note from the perspective of a newer player...

In the past, newer accounts were able to do Alert I and maybe a higher Alert with a support character. As far as I'm aware regarding the numbers, Hard presently falls around Alert V (depending on wave; there's some variance but it seems a good rule of thumb). So, the new Normal mode is a condensation of the old Alert I - IV. At least, that's how it looks to me as a newer player. 

The problem with D-Tide in general is that there are some great, best-in-slot wheels you need in order to really progress through D-Tide... But to earn the currency to buy those wheels, you need to succeed at D-Tide in the first place, which seems a lot more difficult for newer players even before you look at the Madness and Nightmare difficulties. 

I guess newer folks are supposed to spend their Radix Scripts (the pull currency) on Black Fragments? It's convenient now that they've removed the cap on how much you can purchase at once...
